 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 4 06-08-2025 1. Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Sultanganj P.S. Case No. 168 / 2024 registered for the offence under Section 376 of the I.P.C. read with Section 67, 67(A) of the I.T. Act 3.

As per the prosecution case the informant has given written report to the S.H.O., Sultanganj Police Station alleging therein that the petitioner / Keshav Kumar @ Ankit Kumar is the friend of her brother, who died in a road accident on 15.02.2022.
During the CTET examination on 12.01.2023 at Patna the informant arrived at Patna and called the petitioner.
She was taken to the room of the petitioner at Pathar Ki Masjid Patna High Court CR.

4. Mr. Vindhkeshri Kumar, learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that there is inordinate delay in lodging the F.I.R. inasmuch as the occurrence according to the informant has taken place on 12.01.2023 and subsequently on 15.08.2023 however the F.I.R. has been lodged on 25.04.2024.
There was cordial relationship between the petitioner and the informant and the informant used to stay in the room of the petitioner.
If any relation was made that was consensual in nature between Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.86445 of 2024(4) dt.06-08-2025 the petitioner and the informant and both are major.
The informant is a teacher and she refused to undergo medical examination.

5. On the other hand, Mr. Akshay Lal Pandit, learned counsel for the State submits that the statement of the victim girl was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in which she has supported the prosecution story.

6. Notice was issued to the informant / opposite party no. 2.
7.
Learned counsel appearing for the informant submits that informant does not want to oppose the bail of the petitioner.
The petitioner is in custody since 30.07.2024 and charge sheet has already been submitted.
8. Considering the aforesaid submission, the present application is disposed with a direction that the petitioner shall be released on bail after framing of charge by the lower court itself.
